mapper.insert: insert into project (name, customer_dev,is_platform_publish, is_with_goal, priority, type ,status,pm,pm_id,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, `desc`, level, resource_assessment ,pj_establish_start_date,pj_establish_publish_date,create_man_id, create_man) values (#{name}, #{customerDev}, #{isPlatformPublish}, #{isWithGoal}, #{priority}, #{type},#{status}, #{pmName},#{pmId},#{planStartDate},#{planEndDate}, #{desc}, #{level}, #{resourceAssessment},#{pjEstablishStartDate},#{pjEstablishPublishDate}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: select id,name, customer_dev, is_platform_publish, is_with_goal, priority, type ,status, node_status, pm_id,pm pmName ,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`, level, resource_assessment,pj_establish_start_date,pj_establish_publish_date, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where id = #{id} and is_deleted=false

select a.id,a.name, a.customer_dev, a.priority, a.type ,a.status,a.pm_id,a.pm pmName ,a.plan_start_date,a.plan_end_date, a.actual_start_date,a.actual_end_date,a.`desc`, a.create_man_id, a.create_man,a.create_date,a.modify_date from project a left join project_product_demand b on a.id=b.project_id and b.is_deleted=false where b.product_demand_id = #{productDemandId} and a.is_deleted=false

select id,name,is_platform_publish, is_with_goal, customer_dev, priority, type ,status,pm_id,pm pmName ,plan_start_date,plan_end_date, actual_start_date,actual_end_date,`desc`,level, resource_assessment,pj_establish_start_date,pj_establish_publish_date, create_man_id, create_man,create_date,modify_date from project where name = #{name} and is_deleted=false

select pj.id, pj.name, pj.customer_dev, pj.priority, pj.type, pj.status, pj.pm, pj.pm_id, pj.plan_start_date, pj.plan_end_date, pj.actual_start_date, pj.actual_end_date, pj.`desc`, pj.is_deleted, pj.create_man_id, pj.create_man, pj.create_date, pj.modify_man_id, pj.modify_man, pj.modify_date from person p join project pj on p.main_id = pj.id join project_product_line ppl on pj.id = ppl.project_id where p.user_id = #{userId} and pj.status != 40 and pj.status != -20 and ppl.product_line_id = #{productLineId}
